I have reviewed `core/info-theory/entropy.ss` and identified several bugs, performance issues, and numerical stability concerns. My analysis covered Shannon entropy, joint and conditional measures, mutual information, divergence metrics, and sample estimation.

The most critical issue is a logic bug in `cross-entropy` where it incorrectly returns 0 instead of infinity when the second distribution has zero probability for an event that occurs in the first distribution. I also found significant performance bottlenecks in marginal probability calculations and frequency counting that would manifest with large datasets.
